identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to product composition, market, channel, eligibility, availability or governing price plan create immutable Offering or catalogue versions.

owns: catalogue release, withdrawal and retirement history

references.purpose: Recipient-specific quote derived from an Offering
Service Definition referenced by an Offering

excludes: durable Product, Product Family or Edition identity
contract, subscription entitlement, order or fulfilment
independent price-plan root without proven mastership

invariants: Every Offering references one Product or governed bundle composition.
Product may exist without an Offering but Offering cannot exist without a product or bundle reference.
Offering declares market or channel, eligibility and availability interval.
Every price amount declares currency, unit or quantity basis and recurrence class.
Free is explicit zero or a no-charge rule and never missing data.
Subscription semantics belong to Offering or pricing, not Product identity.
A tariff change creates a Price Plan successor and never a new Product automatically.
Recipient-specific quote terms remain in WM-ECO-021 and pin the source Price Plan version.
Offering withdrawal never deletes prior quotes, agreements or entitlements.
Catalogue and Offering releases are immutable and superseded explicitly.
Roadmap intent never proves Offering availability.
Bundle composition and Product Family remain distinct.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Independent Grok review and one frozen semantic audit are pending.
Pricing, bundle and entitlement crosswalks require canonical validation.
Package conversion and live verification are pending.
